games.name: Roblox Blooket
games.desc:
Welcome to Roblox Blooket!
Get ready to dive into a world of trivia, strategy, and endless fun in this Roblox-inspired version of Blooket! Answer questions, earn points, and compete with friends in a variety of thrilling game modes. Whether you're racing to the finish, fishing for epic rewards, or building your way to victory, there's something here for everyone!

💡 Key Features:
- Multiple unique game modes, each offering a different twist on trivia-based gameplay!
- Earn points and unlock rewards as you strategize your way to the top of the leaderboard.
- Play solo or with friends for an exciting competitive or collaborative experience!
- Fun themes, cool items, and surprises waiting to be discovered!
